verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, its own in-product AI agent. Neo is described as able to provision, govern, and 'optimize' your cloud infrastructure, take plain-English requests, and 'monitor outcomes automatically' [pulumi-docs-9, pulumi-docs-20, pulumi-docs-46]. That implies AI working over the user's own infrastructure data, but no evidence shows Neo surfacing insights or recommendations from that data. The MCP server serves external assistants rather than giving insights inside the product, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or recommendations (e.g., cost, drift, or optimization suggestions) surfaced in Pulumi Cloud, detail on what data Neo analyzes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
